headline: AI-driven growth lifted most majors, but revenue pace slowed for the likes of Infosys.
summary: Quarterly revenue rose across the board, led by Coforge's 53.6% surge and strong AI contributions at HCLTech and TCS. Profit margins improved for several firms, yet Infosys trimmed FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% revenue growth. Companies highlighted AI‑led deals, but few disclosed concrete AI revenue numbers. Overall sentiment is positive, with mixed guidance outlooks.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Multiple firms cited AI‑led deals and revenue jumps, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and TCS crossing $3.1 bn AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose for high‑growth players like Coforge (16%) and remained strong at TCS (24%).

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%, while Wipro introduced a modest sequential outlook.
